name: Balanced lookahead rounds, Brent-Kung
description: The circuit of Balanced lookahead rounds with Brent-Kung carry trees for the sums of a round as well, in place of Sklansky trees. A Brent-Kung tree has fewer nodes, so this variant needs fewer qubits and Toffolis, and it is deeper: 1,060 qubits, 77,304 Toffolis, reaction depth 905. Every AND is computed once into a qubit of its own and measured away, and registers are cleared by an X-basis measurement with the phase fixed on the bits of a second sum.
